verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS recruiting platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: per-job email notification muting and an optional applicant EEO survey.
